mn117:5.2: For this view see Sutta 60 (Apaṇṇaka Sutta).
mn117:14.2: ‘Thought, thinking’ (takko vitakko) includes ‘initial application’, which is another translation of vitakka used where it is found in connection with jhāna.
mn117:34.4: Sekha (‘one in the higher training’): a Stream-winner, Once-returner, or Non-returner. ‘Possess the Path’ refers to gaining the first Path (Stream-entry); ‘develop the Path’ refers to gaining the other three Paths.
mn117:36.1: For instance, in the case of right view, there is ‘right view’ (=kamma) and ‘the many profitable dhammas’ dependent on this (=result); ‘wrong view’ and ‘the many evil unprofitable dhammas’ arising dependently (=result): so there are four parts for each factor, making forty for the whole ten factors.
mn117:38.1: It is not known where these people lived. For the views they held, see Suttas 60 (Apaṇṇaka) and 76 (Sandaka).
